>_ Episode 10 · Sep 10, 2026 · 1h 30m

The Problem With The Alignment Problem

Play Episode 10 on YouTube
Watch on YouTube SpotifyApple Podcasts

Is the "AI alignment problem" genuinely the existential challenge of our time, or has it become an intellectual buffer designed to deflect corporate responsibility? In this episode of Philosophy Programs and Prompts, Casey Hart(@OntologyExplained) and Carl Brown(@InternetOfBugs) break down how alignment discourse often muddies AI debates rather than clarifying them. From thought experiments like the paperclip maximizer and the monkey’s paw to recent controversies like model sycophancy, the Hugging Face incident, and corporate data centers, they explore how vague definitions, anthropomorphism, and doomer abstraction distract the public from immediate, real-world harms.
